stem: A data engineer identified an error during a routine daily update to a Delta table. To correct this, they intend to use Delta Lake's time travel feature to revert the table to its state from three days ago. Unfortunately, the data engineer encounters an issue: the time travel attempt fails because the data files necessary for the restoration have been deleted. Which of the following explains why the data files are no longer available?

options.html: The VACUUM command was run on the table
The TIME TRAVEL command was run on the table
The DELETE HISTORY command was run on the table
The OPTIMIZE command was run on the table
The HISTORY command was run on the table

correction: Time travel requires both transaction history and the referenced data files. VACUUM only removes unreferenced files past its retention threshold; the default is seven days. This scenario assumes the needed files were eligible under the configured retention policy.
explain:
✅ সঠিক উত্তর: A

ব্যাখ্যা

Delta time travel-এর জন্য transaction log-এর সঙ্গে সেই version-এর data file-ও থাকতে হয়। VACUUM configured retention পার হওয়া unreferenced file মুছে দিলে পুরোনো version restore/read করা যায় না।

Default retention ৭ দিন। শুধু তিন দিন আগের version বলেই VACUUM তার file মুছে দেয় না; প্রশ্নে প্রয়োজনীয় file retention policy অনুযায়ী deletion-এর জন্য eligible ছিল ধরে নেওয়া হয়েছে। OPTIMIZE compaction করে, কিন্তু পুরোনো file তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে delete করে না। TIME TRAVEL ও DELETE HISTORY নামে এই কাজের standard command নেই।
